rule_0.statement: With forelimb struts sharing approximately s=0.45 of body weight, the hindlimb envelope fits with margin and the quadruped completes full walking cycles.
rule_0.prediction: The native run exceeds tick 426 (two full cycles), keeps the ledger under 10 J, hind knee demand under 0.85 cap, and saturates no joint on more than 10% of loaded ticks.

falsifiers.run: Refusal before tick 426 triggers a bisect at s=0.25, 0.45, and 0.55 and records the named joint and tick.
falsifiers.free_fall: F-G5 free fall remains -9.806650 m/s2 with four legs and no powered contact response.
falsifiers.fore_cap: The fore-elbow cap is the doc-derived 3.76 N.m; demands beyond it are banked as a red finding, never raised away.

design.coordinates: 18 = prior 14 plus shoulder_flexion/elbow_flexion for each forelimb
design.forelimbs: Stage-A two-coordinate load-sharing struts, mounted at the HAT cranial closure (0.2689,-0.1331), using 0.2737 kg humerus/0.125 m and 0.1323 kg forearm/0.132 m constants from the quad-share derivation
design.contacts: four hind sole points plus four forepaw sole points with the existing migrating-CoP row treatment
design.settle: fore contacts active during the existing 60-tick settle window

honest_summary: The quadruped build compiles and preserves honest free-fall and determinism, but the first native run refuses at tick 291 (before tick 426) on positional correction after the fore strut contacts have lifted. The refusal is banked as a dynamic contact/settle finding; ledger and walking falsifiers are red.
